requirements.rule: OVERTIME: Art. 35 weekday weekly bands (15% through the 48th hour, 25% for the 49th, 35% after) split automatically when weekly_hours_before is supplied. Without that position the first tier applies and later tiers are flagged. Night overtime is 61% for the first hour and 76% after; the first hour is interpreted per day, but the engine cannot split a night event by daily hours. Holiday overtime is 71%. Premiums do not accumulate ('la maggiore assorbe la minore', p. 57).
requirements.remediation: Supply weekly_hours_before to split weekday weekly tiers. For night overtime past the first daily hour, supply separately split events with explicit multipliers; daily tiers are not automatically split.
